The '''Ancient Prison Caverns''' was an underground level of chambers located on the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] that existed by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and predated the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prison facilities. It contained alien races completely unknown to the Republic at the time and the [[Esh-kha]] emerged from these levels after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] accidentally released them from [[Force Stasis/Legends|stasis]].
